name: opencli-plugin-google-trends
description: opencli plugin: Google Trends now (Trending Now) + explore (interest + related)

scripts.build: npx esbuild src/now.ts --outfile=now.js --format=esm --platform=node && npx esbuild src/explore-lib.ts --outfile=explore-lib.js --format=esm --platform=node && npx esbuild src/explore.ts --bundle --outfile=explore.js --format=esm --platform=node --packages=external
